note: Real bug case: BASE PRICE and DESTINATION & DELIVERY (right column) land on the same visual row as OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT lines (left column) -- 'RAPTOR SERIES' shares a row with 'BASE PRICE $76,775.00'. A label match anchored at a row's first N words missed both fields entirely (silently -- parse_sticker doesn't raise, it just omits the key). Fixed by matching the label as a subsequence anywhere in the row instead. Pin this one to keep it fixed.
Baseline case where the price rows don't merge with the equipment column -- confirms the subsequence-match fix didn't regress the already-working layout.
